messages.text: Does it dual mine btc and dodge?

Yes — that's the whole point of the Dual: one box with both chains, Bitcoin on SHA-256 and Dogecoin (scrypt, so Litecoin merge-mines with it). It's $999 and ships November 14, 2026.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup you already run?
How many didge coin will it mine in a day?
Read the bsb b30 dual page

Straight answer: I won't guess that one. Daily DOGE depends on the H15's scrypt hashrate and the network difficulty on the day, and I don't have a confirmed figure for this unit — our hardware guy does. I've put it to the team and they'll confirm by email, usually within a business day.
